knowledge:
- key_parameters: bsObject=A bsseq object containing methylation data, typically loaded from an HDF5 file ;; subSample=Optional parameter in report() to specify the number of CpGs to subset for analysis (e.g., 1 million) ;; offset=Optional parameter in report() to skip the first n CpGs to avoid telomeric regions ;; organism=A BSgenome organism object (e.g., Hsapiens, Mmusculus) ;; build=Genomic build string (e.g., "hg38", "mm10") ;; features=A character vector of genomic features of interest (e.g., 'cpg_islands', 'cpg_shores', 'cpg_shelves') ;; windowLength=Window size in base pairs for calculating CpG density (defaults to 1000) ;; mbiasFiles=File path(s) to M-bias text files generated from the alignment pipeline
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation, though HDF5Array is recommended for loading large bsseq objects and annotatr is referenced for genomic features.
- when_to_use: Use this package when performing quality control, coverage assessment, and preprocessing diagnostics on single-cell or bulk bisulfite sequencing (BS-seq, RRBS) datasets, particularly those processed via FireCloud pipelines.
- pitfalls: Repeat regions can mimic CpG islands due to high GC content and length, so repMask should be used to evaluate CpG coverage specifically in non-repeat regions ;; Single-cell methylation data can show jagged trends in methylation bias plots due to low read counts ;; In single-cell methylation, most CpGs should have methylation values near 0 or 1; a high proportion of intermediate methylation values indicates potential sequencing or preparation errors ;; A bisulfite conversion rate below 95% indicates potential issues with sample preparation.

workflows.name: comprehensive_qc_report
workflows.intent: Generate an all-inclusive HTML quality control report for a methylation dataset.
input: directory (directory containing the HDF5-stored bsseq object)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the bsseq object from the HDF5 directory ;; 2. Generate the HTML quality control report using the report function.
workflows.code:
directory <- system.file("extdata", "bismark_data", package='scmeth')
bsObject <- HDF5Array::loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment(directory)
report(bsObject, '~/Documents', Hsapiens, "hg38")

workflows.name: step_by_step_qc_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform individual quality control checks and generate diagnostic metrics for methylation data.
input: directory (directory containing the HDF5-stored bsseq object)
methylationBiasFile (M-bias text file generated from the alignment pipeline)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the bsseq object ;; 2. Calculate basic CpG coverage per sample ;; 3. Visualize read mapping metrics ;; 4. Assess CpG coverage in non-repeat regions ;; 5. Calculate CpG coverage by chromosome ;; 6. Classify CpG coverage by genomic features ;; 7. Calculate CpG density across genomic windows ;; 8. Perform downsampling analysis to assess sequencing saturation ;; 9. Generate and plot methylation bias along reads ;; 10. Calculate methylation distribution across cells ;; 11. Calculate and plot bisulfite conversion rates.
workflows.code:
directory <- system.file("extdata", "bismark_data", package='scmeth')
bsObject <- HDF5Array::loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment(directory)
scmeth::coverage(bsObject)
readmetrics(bsObject)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
load(system.file("extdata", 'bsObject.rda', package='scmeth'))
repMask(bs, Mmusculus, "mm10")
chromosomeCoverage(bsObject)
featureList <- c('cpg_islands', 'cpg_shores', 'cpg_shelves')
DT::datatable(featureCoverage(bsObject, features=featureList, "hg38"))
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.GRCh38)
DT::datatable(cpgDensity(bsObject, Hsapiens, windowLength=1000, small=TRUE))
DT::datatable(scmeth::downsample(bsObject))
methylationBiasFile <- '2017-04-21_HG23KBCXY_2_AGGCAGAA_TATCTC_pe.M-bias.txt'
mbiasList <- mbiasplot(mbiasFiles=system.file("extdata", methylationBiasFile,
                                         package='scmeth'))
mbiasDf <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, mbiasList)
meanTable <- stats::aggregate(methylation ~ position + read, data=mbiasDf, FUN=mean)
sdTable <- stats::aggregate(methylation ~ position + read, data=mbiasDf, FUN=sd)
seTable <- stats::aggregate(methylation ~ position + read, data=mbiasDf, FUN=function(x){sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))})
sum_mt<-data.frame('position'=meanTable$position,'read'=meanTable$read,
                       'meth'=meanTable$methylation, 'sdMeth'=sdTable$methylation,
                       'seMeth'=seTable$methylation)
sum_mt$upperCI <- sum_mt$meth + (1.96*sum_mt$seMeth)
sum_mt$lowerCI <- sum_mt$meth - (1.96*sum_mt$seMeth)
sum_mt$read_rep <- paste(sum_mt$read, sum_mt$position, sep="_")
g <- ggplot2::ggplot(sum_mt)
g <- g + ggplot2::geom_line(ggplot2::aes_string(x='position', y='meth',
                                                colour='read'))
g <- g + ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes_string(ymin = 'lowerCI',
                        ymax = 'upperCI', x='position', fill = 'read'),
                        alpha=0.4)
g <- g + ggplot2::ylim(0,100) + ggplot2::ggtitle('Mbias Plot')
g <- g + ggplot2::ylab('methylation')
g
methylationDist(bsObject)
bsConversionPlot(bsObject)
